selection_boundary.selection_basis: response-blind source architecture, standardized monitoring design, independent coordinate registry and static GitHub blob transport

focal_taxon.selection_rule: first of the four ecologically distinct riverine fishes listed in the independent 2018 branching-network paper after applying the authors' published taxonomy normalization

pre_response_registry.site_id_rule: river concatenated directly with decimal site integer, with no separator

response_endpoint.unit: valid-coordinate monitoring site x ever-recorded Barbatula oreas detection during the frozen 1999-2019 monitoring series
response_endpoint.zero_semantics: program-level recorded non-detection over the released monitoring period, not proof of biological or historical absence or inability to colonize

response_blind_world_geometry.distance_metric: Haversine great-circle distance on released longitude/latitude
response_blind_world_geometry.threshold_population: all unordered same-river pairs among the 126 valid-coordinate nodes
response_blind_world_geometry.edge_rule: undirected local edge when same-river Haversine distance <= frozen threshold
response_blind_world_geometry.external_open_semantics: explicit permissive analytical alternative; unlike local worlds it may connect across watershed identity and must never be interpreted as a local movement graph

layer_a_static_fold_rule.calibration_positive_occurrences: all focal-positive calibration nodes in the current fold
layer_a_static_fold_rule.fixed_source_rule: within every river containing at least one calibration-positive occurrence, the calibration-positive node with the smallest site integer is the fixed source for that river; all remaining calibration-positive nodes are compatibility evidence

features_frozen_from_coordinate_registry: river one-hot encoding with lexicographically frozen category order
conventional_baseline.within_river_site_rank_fraction_rule: zero when river has one node, otherwise zero-based rank by (site_integer, site_id) divided by river_node_count-1
conventional_baseline.river_centroid_rule: arithmetic mean longitude and latitude of valid-coordinate nodes in the river, used only as a deterministic released-coordinate feature
conventional_baseline.nearest_neighbor_rule: minimum Haversine distance to another valid node in same river; zero if river has one node

response_parser_to_freeze_later.focal_match_rule: physical latin == Noemacheilus_barbatulus before published normalization
response_parser_to_freeze_later.ever_detection_rule: site is positive iff at least one frozen response row for the focal physical latin value has abundance > 0
